Releasing, hiding this page or losing its heartbeat requests software cancellation. A stopped/crashed Jetson or broken serial link may prevent zero commands. Use physical power-off if abnormal; do not lift a moving robot.

One attempt per terminal launch, including cancellation/expiry. Reloading or reconnecting cannot rearm it. Reverse, steering, speed controls and automatic retry are unavailable.
